County Assessor’s Office have received several calls about online videos and articles circulating that supposedly offers a “senior break,” “senior freeze” or “senior homeowner tax review.” These programs do not exist, and anyone who views this type of fake information should not click on links regarding these false programs. Some states may offer programs with these types of names, but Minnesota does not. Please contact the assessor’s office if you have questions.
